title: Virtual Employment: Remote Graphic Designer
description:
Are you a highly skilled Graphic Designer with expertise in Photoshop and Canva? Do you thrive in a remote work environment and possess a deep passion for creating captivating designs? If so, we invite you to join our dynamic team of creative professionals at Siegen Solutions as a Remote Graphic Designer.
About Us:
Siegen Solutions is a recruitment firm that partners with a diverse range of local and international companies to deliver exceptional design solutions. We are seeking talented Graphic Designers to collaborate remotely with remote employers. As a Remote Graphic Designer, you will play a crucial role in enhancing your remote employers growth and success through the power of compelling design.
Key Responsibilities:
As a Remote Graphic Designer, you will:

• Create captivating and innovative designs for your remote employer

• Collaborate closely with your remote employer, taking ownership of creative tasks and contributing to client growth and development.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring precise execution, pixel-perfect detail, and timely delivery.

• Generate stunning designs across diverse projects, including logo and brand identity design, presentation design, digital ads and marketing materials, illustrations, print design, product and packaging visuals, web design, and more.

• Support employer in achieving their goals, driving growth, and delivering substantial business value through exceptional design.

Qualifications and Requirements:

• Availability to work within the US/Canada/UK/Australia/Singapore time zones.

• Applicants must have their own computer equipment and a quiet nook at home where they can work without distraction.

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Design, Creative, Communications, or a related field.

• Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

• Proficiency in presentation and graphic design using tools such as Photoshop, Canvas, Illustrator, InDesign, PowerPoint, etc., along with a robust portfolio showcasing your work.

• Demonstrated expertise in using Figma for design projects, with the ability to collaborate effectively and produce high-quality work within the platform.

• Ability to quickly grasp processes and efficiently manage multiple projects with meticulous attention to detail.

• Exceptional design skills and a commitment to delivering top-notch quality and direction.

• A proactive, client-centric, and execution-driven mindset, with a strong bias for action and a strong work ethic.

• Good to Have: Proven track record of advancement within a top-tier creative agency.

If you're ready to make a significant impact through your exceptional design skills and want to be part of a globally recognized creative agency, apply now and include your resume, portfolio, and a cover letter detailing your qualifications and enthusiasm for this role.
We look forward to welcoming you to the Siegen Solutions remote team!
Note: Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. We appreciate your interest in joining our team.

title: Medical School Admissions Consultant - Resident Physician
description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place-disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role
We are looking for a Medical School Admissions Consultant ! If you are currently in residency and passionate about mentorship, coaching, and helping students reach their full potential in the medical school admissions process, this could be the role for you. You’ll work closely with pre-med and medical school applicants to track their progress, strengthen their applications, and guide them through every step of the med school admissions journey, including AMCAS and AACOMAS applications. This is a part-time, remote, 1099 contract role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.
Responsibilities

• Work with prospective medical school candidates and pre-med students, helping them identify opportunities to build their profile and draft compelling medical school application materials

• Manage relationships with applicants and families while providing strategic and tactical guidance on medical school selection, essays, resumes, letters of recommendation, interviews, and the overall medical school admissions process

• Identify optimal medical programs and medical schools for individual students; provide feedback and guidance to students regarding their research on university programs and relevant admissions resources, ensuring alignment with the student’s background and career goals

• Support students with project planning, application timeline management, and progress tracking through internal organizational tools

• Stay up to date on the medical school admissions landscape, including program requirements and admissions criteria, to advise prospective and existing clients on appropriate school selection and the nuances of applying to medical school

Qualifications

• Currently in your residency program (MD or DO)

• Graduated from a U.S. medical school

• Previous experience on a medical school admissions committee, including reviewing applications and participating in acceptance and rejection decisions

• A passion for mentorship and coaching pre-med students

• Strong planning and organizational skills

• Strong English reading, writing, and editing skills, particularly for medical school essays and personal statements

• Strong verbal communication skills

• Expertise in project management and applicant tracking

• Experience in education, coaching, tutoring, or mentoring students

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

title: Legal Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description:
Work Location: US, remote
Engagement Model:  Freelancer / Independent Contractor
Project duration: 3 months (with potential extension)
Work Schedule : Flexible hours, based on the applicant's availability
Language skills required: English
DataForce by TransPerfect is seeking experienced Legal Subject Matter Experts (SME) with sharp analytical skills and a deep understanding of legal frameworks to join our AI training and model development team. The ideal candidate will bring broad expertise in the legal sector, including litigation, corporate law, regulatory compliance, contract management, and intellectual property, to help train, evaluate, and fine-tune AI models. Your goal is to ensure the highest levels of accuracy, jurisdictional relevance, and logical reasoning within the AI’s output.
You will work with cross-functional teams of data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams to build intelligent legal solutions such as automated contract review tools, legal research assistants, and compliance monitoring engines. The goal is to construct high-quality datasets that represent realistic, end-to-end legal workflows and professional skills.
Main Responsibilities

• Domain Oversight: Serve as the primary legal authority during the training and fine-tuning of AI models, ensuring all outputs adhere to legal standards and correct terminology.

• Knowledge Architecture: Develop knowledge bases, legal taxonomies, and ontologies that reflect multi-jurisdictional standards and complex legal hierarchies.

• Data Validation: Annotate, label, and validate datasets with specific legal knowledge (e.g., case law citations, statutory interpretations, and contractual clauses).

• Prompt Engineering & Strategy: Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to design training data strategies and prompt engineering techniques specifically tailored for legal reasoning and drafting.

• Model Audit: Provide expert feedback on model outputs, identifying "hallucinations," legal inaccuracies, or ambiguities to improve the model’s reliability in high-stakes environments.

• Business Alignment: Partner with product teams to align AI capabilities with legal objectives, such as reducing discovery timelines or automating risk assessment.

• Regulatory Watch: Stay current with emerging trends in LegalTech and AI-related regulations to ensure ethical and compliant model implementation.

Role Requirements

• Education: Juris Doctor (JD) or Master of Laws (LLM) from an accredited law school. Active bar membership is a plus.

• Experience: 5 years of experience in the legal sector (e.g., private practice, in-house counsel, or legal research).

• Analytical Precision: Proven ability to translate complex legal processes into structured logic and data requirements.

• Communication: Exceptional writing and verbal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical AI teams and legal stakeholders.

• Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with legal tech stacks such as CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management), eDiscovery platforms, or legal research databases (Westlaw/LexisNexis).

• Awareness of ethical Generative AI practices , including bias detection and responsible data usage.

• Familiarity with Generative AI concepts , prompt engineering, and data preparation is a plus.

DataForce by TransPerfect is part of the TransPerfect family of companies, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business, with offices in more than 100 cities worldwide. We offer high-quality data for Human-Machine Interaction to some of the most prestigious technology companies in the world. W  T&P  łączymy kreatywność, technologię i media, by dostarczać naszym Klientom kompleksowe rozwiązania komunikacyjne. Nasza przedsiębiorcza struktura działa w 45 biurach na czterech kontynentach.

title: Sales Director, New Business - Financial Services
Care Expert - Customer Training (m/f/d)
description:
🎤 WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE’RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 YOUR MISSION

As a Care Expert, you are the trusted care advisor for voize's most important care group customers. Together with their Customer Success Manager, you make sure voize really changes how care teams work - not just that it goes live. You speak with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer, because you have done their job. Your success shows in adoption and in the time teams get back.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS

- Support 6-10 strategic care group accounts as their care expert, side by side with their Customer Success Manager

- Look at QM processes, documentation routines and the EHR setup (e.g. Vivendi) before go-live, so mismatches surface early instead of during rollout

- Talk with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer about process design, how documentation is structured, and change management - in their language, not ours

- Review adoption with customer leadership after go-live and share clear, practical recommendations on voize settings and on care workflows

- Bring what you see across accounts back to our Product team, and name clearly what is a process topic, an EHR setup topic, or a real product need

🤝 YOUR SKILLSET

- You have worked as Pflegedienstleitung, QM-Beauftragte/r or in a similar senior care quality or operations role - at the level of the people you will advise

- You know QM processes, care documentation standards and EHR systems (ideally Vivendi/Snap) in stationärer Altenpflege

- You speak fluent German and can meet a careful Pflegedienstleitung, a cautious Geschäftsführung and a busy IT admin on the same day, each in their own way

- You think in a structured way and can tell whether something is a process topic, a system setup topic, or a change management topic - and what helps in each case

- You enjoy close collaboration: with CSMs, with Product, and on building the Care Expert playbook together

🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle new topics, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care

- We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely from Germany

- Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

- Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible

- You decide when you work best; that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

✨ READY TO TALK? APPLY NOW! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

title: Power Systems Studies Engineer - Dynamic Modeling
description:
The Opportunity
Ulteig is currently seeking talented and motivated Studies level engineering candidates to support power system studies and transmission planning projects within the renewable energy and power markets
What You'll Do
The Studies Engineer for the dynamic studies team is expected to perform the following tasks:

• Develop PSSE, PSLF, TSAT, and PSCAD models of renewable plants

• Perform model quality tests and model benchmarking for various software models

• Understand dynamic model block diagrams and tune parameters to meet regional model performance requirements

• Design and model custom master plant controls for large multi-resource renewable projects (PV, BESS, Datacenters)

• Research and test relatively new available models of datacenter loads and understand the challenges posed to the grid

• Work closely with the business development team to understand customer needs and application

• Work with SCADA engineers in charge of building and implementing master plant controls

• Support proposal efforts by demonstrating theoretical renewable generation and datacenter co-located plant operation

• Model master plant control in parallel with the design of master plant control to understand and mitigate any challenges

• Respond quickly to customer design changes, questions, and deadlines, and maintain a flexible attitude toward the work

• Stay current with regulatory changes, new grid codes, and evolving ISO/RTO requirements related to grid interconnections

• Conduct various dynamic simulations including voltage and frequency ride through, voltage step change, frequency step change, SCR tests, and fault analyses

• Support model validation and model benchmarking

• Stay up to date on new industry guidance and standards for modeling and requirements for inverter-based resources and datacenters

• Help develop tools to automate and streamline model quality tests and analyses

What We Expect from You

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering required, ABET accredited program, or equivalent required

• A minimum of 5 years of working experience directly related to power systems or control systems

• Experience with Matlab Simulink

• Experience with dynamic analysis utilizing PSS®E and PSCAD software, preferred

• Experience in conducting analysis on multi-resource renewable projects, preferred

• Experience developing custom user-defined models in PSS®E or PSCAD software, preferred

• Experience with programming in Python, preferred

• Actively manages individual workload, adapts to changing requirements, maintains flexibility

• Must be a self-starter and willing to identify improvements and implement them, utilizing support from others

• Must be comfortable asking questions to team when learning new skills · Must be analytical, self-motivated, and possess the ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a positive, enthusiastic attitude

• Excellent presentation and verbal/written communications skills

• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, management, clients and external agencies

• Innovative mindset

• Permanent authorization to work in the U.S

You might not meet 100% of the skills listed in a description, but we are committed to hiring people with exceptional talent, ability and potential, and then creating an environment where they can become the best versions of themselves. We don’t want to miss out on the possibility of speaking with the next outstanding Ulteig team member, so please apply if you think this role is a great match for your unique skills and strengths. title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Infrastructure)
description:
About the role:
The cybersecurity team at FYUL is deliberately small and execution-focused. Its engineering branch runs the company's security operations backbone: a large-scale telemetry and detection platform covering endpoints, network traffic, cloud workloads, and SaaS - a modern SIEM at its core, extended with substantial custom machine learning and AI agents that this team designs and builds itself. This senior engineer role, reporting directly to the Information Security Engineering Manager, owns significant parts of that platform: detection engineering, vulnerability discovery, cloud and endpoint security, data loss prevention, and the automation of security operations.
This is an individual-contributor position where professional growth comes from depth of expertise and ownership of outcomes. The security program is mature, with governance and compliance handled by a dedicated GRC function - so this role is about building and running security engineering, full-time.
Your daily tasks will include:

• Detection engineering. Design, implement, and tune detections across our security telemetry - SIEM rules as well as custom ML models for anomaly and risk detection. Triage alerts, investigate real incidents, and drive them to closure - including technical incident response and post-incident improvement.

• Cloud and platform security. Harden and monitor our AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) environments: workload security, IAM, container runtime defense, and configuration standards. Collaborate with engineering teams so security lands as enablement, not friction.

• Endpoint security. Own the health and hardening of the endpoint agent fleet across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

• Data loss prevention. Operate and extend DLP coverage across removable media, email, and SaaS channels: telemetry-driven detection of data exfiltration, tuned to keep false positives low.

• Security automation. Automate recurring operations and detection-to-response workflows - including AI-based agents and pipelines, which are already a working part of this program. Prefer integrating established tooling over bespoke development where it delivers the same outcome.

• Vulnerability discovery and management. Find infrastructure vulnerabilities yourself - through scanning, configuration review, and targeted penetration testing of our environments - then prioritize and drive remediation to closure. This is not an application security role: a dedicated sub-team covers appsec.

Your qualifications:

• 5+ years in security engineering or SecOps roles with hands-on responsibility for detections and incidents in production - not solely policy or advisory work.

• Real detection engineering experience on a modern SIEM/security platform (Elastic Security preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, or comparable count), and the appetite to go beyond built-in rules into custom ML-based detection.

• Deep, hands-on mastery of Linux, macOS, and Windows: internals, hardening, and investigation on all three. You have personally hunted or hardened systems on each of them, not just one favorite.

• Strong networking expertise: TCP/IP, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and packet-level analysis - you can reconstruct what happened from a packet capture and reason about how traffic actually flows through our environments.

• Strong cloud security foundation in AWS, including Kubernetes; you have personally secured and monitored production cloud workloads.

• Hands-on LLM experience. You have built or operated LLM-powered tooling - agents, pipelines, or detection/automation workflows - not merely used a chat assistant. Our security program already runs AI agents in production; you will extend that work.

• A certification in practical infrastructure hacking or hardening - e.g., OSCP, OSEP, or a comparable hands-on offensive credential. This matters more to us than knowledge-exam certifications.

• Demonstrated automation capability: scripts, integrations, pipelines, or AI-assisted workflows you can sho

Maxibook is an early-stage AI startup rethinking how scientific knowledge is delivered, organized, and personalized .
We are building an Adaptive Knowledge System powered by dynamic knowledge maps and LLM-driven adaptive content , with an MVP expected by Q1 2026 .
Our initial focus is on universities, research institutions, and publicly funded initiatives , with future expansion into the corporate HR sector (onboarding, continuous training, skill-gap reduction).
We are entering the fundraising phase and looking for passionate contributors who want to help us build the foundations of a global platform .
Tasks
Scientific Language & AI Adaptation Contributor (Korean / Japanese / Arabic)
We are looking for contributors who can help us adapt English scientific content to languages with fundamentally different writing systems, grammar, and conceptual structures , working in close collaboration with AI tools.
This is not a translation role .
At Maxibook, content is generated and adapted through AI. Our challenge is understanding how meaning, structure, tone, and scientific precision change when moving from English to languages such as Korean, Japanese, or Arabic - where:

• sentence construction follows different logical flows

• terminology is built differently

• writing conventions for science and education differ

• correctness cannot be validated by English speakers alone

What you will actually do

• Help us understand how scientific and educational language works in your language

• Explain how concepts are normally structured, introduced, and developed in written form

• Guide the correct use of AI for linguistic adaptation , not just literal translation

• Review and validate AI-generated outputs to ensure they are:

• conceptually accurate

• natural and credible in your language

• appropriate for scientific and academic contexts

• Identify when an AI translation is formally correct but conceptually or stylistically wrong

• Suggest tools, workflows, or strategies to reliably adapt English content using AI

This role is about making AI-generated knowledge reliable in languages we do not personally speak .
Who this is for

• Native or near-native speakers of Korean, Japanese, or Arabic

• People who deeply understand written language conventions , especially for science or education

• Translators, researchers, educators, developers, or AI-literate contributors

• Anyone able to explain how and why things are written the way they are in their language

You don’t need to translate everything manually.
You need to help us build confidence in AI-driven adaptation .
Why this role matters
Simply asking an AI to “translate to Japanese or Arabic” is not enough.
Without linguistic insight, we cannot verify correctness, clarity, or credibility.
Your contribution helps Maxibook:

• avoid superficial or misleading translations

• design better multilingual AI workflows

• deliver scientific knowledge that actually works across languages and cultures

You will help shape how global scientific knowledge is adapted, not just translated .
Bring your enthusiasm, skills, and curiosity into the project. Every contribution matters - you’ll help lay the bricks of a system that could redefine the future of education.
Requirements
We welcome both experienced professionals and early-career talents - what matters most is your genuine interest in AI, education, and the desire to learn and grow with the project.

• Genuine interest in AI, education, or digital innovation

• Willingness to commit a few hours per week (flexible, milestone-based)

• Desire to learn, experiment, and grow together with the project

• No need to leave your current job or studies - join us part-time while we bootstrap funding

Benefits
We are early-stage, and contributions are currently on a voluntary and/or micro-equity basis , depending on role, commitment, and duration.

• Lead technical analysis based on initial Product/UX Acceptance Criteria. Define sequence/state diagrams, API contracts, and write functional specifications (MD/Gherkin) before writing code.

• Model complex state flows and design resilient interface architectures capable of operating in high-traffic, low-latency environments.

• Translate business scenarios into clear acceptance criteria and well-structured system behaviors, actively collaborating with the Automation QA team.

• Design components and abstractions with long-term maintainability in mind, anticipating edge cases, critical bugs, and bottlenecks

What we look for in an exceptional candidate

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, providing the foundation needed to have worked through the level of complexity required for problem-solving.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience managing critical state flows in web applications or concurrent platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to create technical documentation prior to development (OpenAPI/Swagger specs, UML/sequence diagrams, Markdown technical specs).

• Familiarity with defining business-oriented scenarios using Given-When-Then / Gherkin.

• Strong foundations in computer science or software engineering (design patterns, data structures, browser performance), beyond narrow expertise in a particular library.

• Experience or working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, UI libraries/frameworks such as React, and Node.js environments.

Bonus points if you also have

• Experience working on high-traffic, high-concurrency, or real-time data platforms.

• Experience going through complex production incidents or post-mortems that have shaped your approach to preventing errors through clear specifications.

• Knowledge of event-driven architecture or real-time API technologies (WebSockets, Server-Sent Events)

How we do things
BetWarrior is a company in expansion. The team is fast-moving, collaborative, and demanding - with high standards for quality and a genuine commitment to building something that lasts. We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are looking for people who want to grow with the company, take ownership of their work, and be part of building a regional team that operates at a high level across multiple markets.
For the right person, this is an opportunity to join at a stage where your contribution is visible, your growth is real, and the path forward is defined by what you deliver - not by time in role.
We expect every team member to live our values
Accountability & Ownership -Take charge, own your craft
Reliability -Deliver with quality and consistency

At the center is Albus, our AI agent for identity - mining roles, approving access, and catching the drift humans miss.

You'll ship work that thousands of IT and security teams touch every day. You'll own problems without playbooks, because the category is being redefined in real time - by us.

Why Lumos?

- 🚀 Jump on a rocketship. Since launching out of stealth in April 2022, we've grown from 20 to ~130 Alchemists and raised over $65M from a16z, Scale, Neo, Greg Brockman (President at OpenAI), and Phil Venables (CISO at Google).

- 🏆 A culture worth joining. Three years running on Forbes' Top 100 Best Startup Employers in America (2024, 2025, 2026) - measured on culture, retention, growth, and job creation. That's our Alchemists, not our marketing. See what we live by here https://blog.lumos.com/p/the-anatomy-of-an-alchemist.

AI agents are on every company laptop. They are on more cloud workloads each week. The numbers are going up and to the right, fast. These agents act with whatever access the person running them has. Security teams can't see which tools their agents call, let alone approve or block them. Lumos is building the governance layer for these agents, and we're rolling it out to customers right now.

As a Software Engineer on AI Agent Governance at Lumos, you have massive opportunity to help build a brand new product from the ground up in one of the fastest moving markets in software. You'll join a small team who ships fast.

✨ Your Responsibilities

- Ship backend features end to end, from a rough customer ask to running in production, often in days rather than weeks.

- You don’t just ship to a spec, rather you ensure value is delivered to customers. You are a valued member of the oncall rotation.

- Build the testing systems and harnesses that let agents ship changes safely.

- Work directly with customers when issues arise.

- You utilize agents heavily in your day to day work, but you have a deep understanding of the system architecture and can whiteboard it for a coworker at a moment’s notice.

🙌 What We’re Looking For

- 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, or an equivalent track record of shipping real products

- Strong backend fundamentals. You've built APIs, databases and services that run in production. Our stack is Python, Postgres, OpenSearch and gRPC on AWS.

- You're AI native. You understand how agents work under the hood: tool calls, MCP servers, hooks and context.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity. You've worked somewhere small and fast, you start before the spec is finished, and you change direction when customers tell you something new.

- You take ownership. This is a high-intensity role on a product that's still finding product market fit. We work hard and move fast, and we want people who are excited by that.

title: Security Systems Technician
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

- Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

- The industry's playbook was written for one building at a time. Vendor-managed appliances, manual process, and standards that assume a security team walks the floor. None of that survives contact with what we're building, so we build what should exist rather than buying what does.

- Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.

ROLE SCOPE

- Keep the systems online. Keep the campus's cameras, readers, door controllers, intercoms, and the head-end servers, storage and switches behind them online and reporting. Find the root cause of each failure before replacing hardware.

- Repair on-site infrastructure. Troubleshoot and repair cable runs, failed drives, power supplies, DIMMs, NICs and optics, degraded RAID sets, and hosts that fail to boot. Keep the as-builts and device inventory current.

- Accept new builds. Accept new data centers and expansions from the delivery team: walk down their work and the integrator's against the acceptance criteria before it enters support. Help with commissioning when the schedule requires it.

- Work the remediation queue. Work the on-site remediation queue to the response targets in the support agreement: device swaps, firmware updates, resets, and the service requests that used to be integrator truck rolls. Escort and verify outside technicians when they are needed.

- Keep site hardware working. Keep the hardware the guard force, GSOC and site operations use working: badge printers, visitor kiosks, turnstiles and vehicle gates.

description:
Description
Sentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale. Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Unlike alternatives that copy data to vendor clouds or require customer-managed outpost infrastructure, Sentra provisions ephemeral scanners directly inside the customer's environment, delivering petabyte-scale classification at a fraction of the cost. Trusted by Lyft, SoFi, Munich RE, PennyMac, Glovo and others.
Sentra is hiring its first US Classification Data Analyst to be the go-to expert on data classification for our US customers. You will join the Solutions Architecture team, reporting to the Director of Solutions Architecture, and work closely with our R&D Data Analysts team in Israel.
Classification is what customers judge us on during proofs of value (PoVs) and renewals: do our results match their data? You will make sure the answer is yes. You will own classification requests for US PoVs, validate results before customer calls, tune classifiers using proven procedures, and bring the hard problems to R&D with everything they need to solve them.
This is a high-impact role at a fast-growing startup. You will help build the US classification function from the ground up, and your scope will grow as you take on more of the work.
Responsibilities

• Be the first point of contact for classification requests from US customers and PoVs, working with Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, TAMs, Support and Customer Success.

• Own classification on PoV engagements: validate results before customer calls and join those calls as the classification expert in the room.

• Tune classification using approved procedures: add and remove keywords, build customer-specific regex and dictionary classes, run re-analysis, review customer-built classes and manage allowlists.

• Find false positives and false negatives before customers do, and explain clearly why something was classified the way it was and what will change.

• Escalate complex issues to the R&D Data Analysts team with a complete, well-written handoff they can act on without a follow-up call.

• Track every request and its outcome, and turn that data into insight on volume, trends, and where we can improve.

• Proactively look across PoVs to spot what is working, what is not, and what needs to change in our classification, our process, or our runbooks.

• Keep our runbooks current: report gaps, propose fixes, and update instructions as the product evolves.

Requirements

• 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (support engineering, solutions engineering, TAM, data analyst, or similar) at a SaaS or security company.

• Startup experience. You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast, and take ownership without waiting to be asked.

• A proactive mindset. You look for problems and improvements before they become customer issues.

• Working SQL. You can write and adapt queries in Athena or a similar engine.

• Regular expressions. You can read, write, and test patterns and explain their false positive behavior.

• Git and code literacy. You understand how Git and pull requests work and can read and follow code, such as a Python script. You do not need to be a developer, and using AI tools like Claude to help write code is welcome, as long as you understand what the code does.

• Clear, structured communication. You can explain technical results to a customer and write a handoff that a teammate can act on without a call.

• Location reside on the East Coast USA

Nice to have

• Familiarity with data classification, DLP or DSPM concepts (PII, PCI, PHI, data classes, false positive rates).

• Exposure to cloud data stores such as S3, Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft 365, and how sensitive data shows up in them.

Positioned at the intersection of applied data science and software engineering, you focus on the quality, semantic structuring, and retrieval accuracy of data consumed by G.E.H.A’s AI solutions. Your work will also cover dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) and power-management control system technologies for next-generation data-center GPUs.

You will work at the intersection of hardware architecture, embedded firmware, device drivers, operating systems, and AI workloads. Your responsibilities will span the entire product lifecycle-from initial architectural design and pre-silicon validation through silicon bring-up, productization, and deployment in extensive data-center infrastructures. This is an outstanding chance to influence how next-generation NVIDIA GPUs provide top-tier performance, energy efficiency, and reliability.

• Architect, build, implement, and debug GPU power- and performance-management software, with particular emphasis on P-state management and DVFS.

• Develop real-time controllers, policies, and mechanisms that dynamically optimize GPU performance, power, thermals, and energy efficiency under demanding data-center workloads.

• Drive features across the full product lifecycle: requirements, architecture, implementation, pre-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, productization, and production support.

• Develop validation strategies and automation for functional correctness, transition latency, performance-per-watt, and robustness across operating conditions.

• Build clear architecture, interface, and compose specifications for new power-management features.

• Partner with geographically distributed architecture, ASIC, firmware, driver, validation, platform, and data-center systems teams.

• BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field-or equivalent experience.

• Proven ability to independently debug complex problems across multiple software and hardware layers.

Developers find tools by searching, by asking an LLM, and, more and more, by prompting a coding agent to do the work. We’re hiring a technical Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to make sure that across all three, Chainguard gets discovered, recommended, and used.

A daily coding-agent habit, with opinions on how agents choose tools and where they fail.

A track record of driving work through cross-functional partners without direct authority, in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Experience in cybersecurity or the cloud-native ecosystem (containers, Kubernetes, software supply chain security).

We are a fast-moving food and beverage startup developing coconut-based beverages and nutrition products for global markets. title: Payroll Specialist
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Factory is growing quickly, and we're looking for a Payroll Specialist to own payroll operations end to end and be a key member of our finance and accounting team.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership: keeping employees and contractors paid accurately, compliantly, and on time wherever we operate, while building the systems, controls, and documentation that help payroll keep pace as we grow. You will work closely with Finance, People, and leadership, with room to set the function up the right way.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Run full-cycle payroll for our US and international employees, including multi-state payroll

- Process commissions, draws, bonuses, equity vesting, severance, and other variable pay with the right tax withholding

- Handle compensation changes, new hires, terminations, and off-cycle payments

- Manage payroll tax registrations, deposits, filings, and notices at the federal, state, and local level, and work with our providers on international payroll tax

- Manage our international payroll and EOR providers, and set up payroll when we start hiring in a new country

- Administer 401(k) contributions, benefits deductions, garnishments, and contractor payments

- Work with Accounting on payroll journal entries, accruals, and month-end close, and handle quarter-end and year-end work, including W-2s

- Build the processes, controls, and documentation that let payroll scale as we grow

- Work with People, Finance, Tax, and Legal to keep employee data accurate and answer payroll questions

- Use AI and automation to cut down manual work in reconciliations and reporting

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of payroll experience, including running multi-state US payroll at a fast-growing company

- Hands-on experience with payroll platforms like Rippling, Workday, or ADP

- Strong knowledge of US payroll tax, including federal, state, and local withholding, filings, and year-end reporting

- Experience processing commissions, bonuses, and equity compensation (RSUs, ISOs, NSOs)

- Experience with international payroll and EOR providers

- Strong attention to detail and good judgment with confidential information

- Comfortable at a fast-moving startup where you build processes as you go

- Clear communicator who works well with Finance, People, Tax, and Legal

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, HR, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

NICE TO HAVE

- CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) certification

- Experience with Rippling payroll

- Experience building out payroll at a company that grew quickly

- Experience using AI tools to automate payroll or finance workflows

- Experience with SOX, IPO readiness, or setting up financial controls

Location: This role will be onsite 5 days a week in San Francisco

title: Senior Associate, Project Finance
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
The Senior Associate, Project Finance, plays a critical role in executing the financing of Pivot Energy’s projects. Where an Associate executes defined tasks within a process maintained by others, the Senior Associate carries an established process forward, running assigned facility workflows through a full cycle from prior-cycle materials with limited intervention and high accuracy. The Senior Associate will lead diligence workflows and certain funding workflows with the guidance and support of Managers and Directors, serve as the anchored owner of assigned facility workflows within Project Finance's Associate operating model, and coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure financing readiness and compliance across active facilities. Managers retain ownership of the financing outcome, material exceptions, negotiations, and final approvals, and the role does not include direct people management or the construction of financial models.

We appreciate your interest in partnering with us; however, we are not seeking recruitment agency support for this role.

ABOUT PIVOT

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and
families.
 
We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. We believe global warming poses an existential threat to our planet and that we have a responsibility to help mitigate the threat. Our portfolio includes projects that reduce energy burden for income-limited families, create workforce pathways for under-represented groups within the solar industry, and include robust community investment opportunities.
 
As a Certified B Corporation and one of Denver’s “Best Places to Work”, we believe that company success is driven by a healthy environment, thriving society, and workplace where all individuals are respected. We evaluate every internal decision on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors to determine if our actions will result in a net positive impact on the community, our employees, customers, shareholders, and the environment. Learn more in our annual ESG Report.
 
At Pivot, our core values guide our work internally and externally:
·       Impact - We hold ourselves accountable to having a measurable impact on our people, communities, and the planet
·       Balance - Put family first; work hard/have fun
·       Determination - Find ways to be successful no matter how difficult the challenge
·       Professionalism - Impress everyone we touch, be a team player
·       Honesty - Be truthful and transparent, externally and internally
·       Kindness - Create an environment where kindness, empathy, and vulnerability are embraced
 
DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION and JUSTICE STATEMENT
 
At Pivot, we are proactively developing and maintaining an inclusive culture, rooted in mutual respect, that supports a workforce of different generations, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, ability statuses, religions, and cultures to work collaboratively together for greater impact. We seek to build a team that invests in relationship building, celebrates each other’s successes, and makes space for the unique contributions and working styles people bring into Pivot. 
Pivot invests in company-wide trainings, assessments, and programs to advance internal inclusion and equity practices, such as employee allyship building, cross-cultural communications, and equitable hiring and management protocols to increasingly recognize bias and ensure mutual respect and belonging.

title: Associate Manager Inventory Control, Rhode
description:
About the Company
 
e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face. 
 
Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.
 
In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands. 
 
Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (paid at 200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry. 
 
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us

Under the direction of the Senior (IC) Manager, the Inventory Analyst will work with e.l.f. Beauty’s third-party logistics (3PL) providers and Contract Manufacturers by managing our inventory at multiple locations. Tasks would be receiving componentry, completing production work orders and processing shipments in ERP systems. The Associate Manager will work closely with, but not limited to, order management, transportation, production and supply planners, the accounting team, and third-party providers to support keeping the inventory accurate. The Associate Manager will assist them in duties related to inventory Sox compliance, systemic variances, and inventory reconciliations for each partner. Inventory destruction, damages, donations, eComm inventory fulfillment, and cycle count program. Also, the individual will perform other related responsibilities as assigned. This includes participating in e.l.f.’s Continuous Improvement program. This is a Hybrid role consisting of 3 days in office and 2 days WFH available.

The base salary range for this role is listed above. 
 
Total compensation includes base salary, annual company-based performance bonus, and equity. Under e.l.f.’s annual bonus program, employees are eligible to earn up to 200% of their target bonus when company performance exceeds defined goals. In addition, e.l.f. provides a variety of other benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a retirement savings plan, gender neutral parental leave, and unlimited paid time off. The amount of total compensation (including base salary) offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including geographic location, experience, specific skills, and qualifications.
 
Compensation components are subject to change at the company’s discretion

title: Internship
description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. The Role This is a 4-month program: 3 months in Berlin, 1 month in New York. You’ll join one of our tracks (CEO Office, Growth, Product, Ops or Talent) and own real work from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects. Recent projects run by interns: Rebuilt our talent engine and cut time-to-fill from 82 days to 34.

title: IT Delivery Manager (Remote - US)
description:
Overview
World Travel Holdings is seeking an experienced, remote IT Delivery Manager to help us deliver innovative solutions that make leisure travel more accessible and fun. This crucial role will oversee and lead a team of business analysts, scrum masters and project managers in a hybrid waterfall/agile process and partner with strategic business partners and technical leaders to bridge the gap between business and technology. The ideal candidate will be an excellent critical and strategic thinker, be a strong team leader, and have a deep understanding of business analysis and project management methodologies, responsibilities, and best practices.
About the Company
World Travel Holdings , headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, is the nation’s largest cruise agency and an award‑winning leisure travel company with nearly 40 travel brands. Through owned brands and private‑label partnerships, we sell cruises, villas, resort day passes, and luxury travel services. With a top-rated franchise, a UK cruise division, and a strong commitment to employee engagement and remote work, World Travel Holdings offers a people-focused culture. Learn more: WorldTravelHoldings.com
Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Management

• Lead and manage a team of business analysts, scrum masters and project managers providing guidance, support, coaching and fostering a collaborative and innovative team environment

• Establish and maintain best practices for requirements gathering, documentation and stakeholder engagement

• Set clear performance expectations and ensure accountability for delivery commitments

• Foster a culture of growth, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement

• Position yourself and the team as technical and business thought leaders, to drive business outcomes through a deep understanding of technology

• Train, mentor, and support teams in Agile and Waterfall methodologies

Business & Technology Alignment

• Partner with Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into clear, actionable requirements

• Maintain a holistic understanding of business processes, customer journeys, and technical dependencies

• Build a strong understanding of the technical ecosystem, across the front end experiences to the back end services and APIs

• Jira administrator, trainer and champion the adoption of BA tools, including project and technical documentation repositories and knowledge bases

Program Management & Delivery Oversight

• Lead the development and execution of long-range portfolio plans, defining scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets

• Establish governance structures for decision-making, escalation, and reporting

• Oversee resource planning and allocation for project managers, scrum masters, business analysts, and cross-functional delivery teams

• Act as Program Manager across all delivery tracks, managing dependencies, risks, and milestones holistically

• Provide unified program status, risks, and priorities to leadership

• Ensure scope, timeline, and budget adherence for all projects

• Proactively escalate issues and provide solution-oriented recommendations

• Manage projects through the full life cycle: Initiating, Planning, Executing, Monitoring & Controlling, and Closing

• Lead Scrum Masters in effective Agile ceremonies and Project Managers in roadmap delivery

Requirements Management

• Oversee the end-to-end process of gathering, analyzing, and developing business requirements documents and user stories

• Develop and maintain high-quality artifacts including business requirements, acceptance criteria, business process flows and system interaction diagrams

• Ensure requirements reflect scalability, security, quality and usability considerations

• Maintain and improve governance practices and tools (project intake, prioritization, status reporting, retrospectives, planning)

• Perform high level business requirements gathering and assessments early in the project life
